scores.rationale: Complete bank of 21 genuine C of A cast brass PO box doors with keys; strong decor and memorabilia demand, roughly $300-500.

Mobiloil A bottle with Pegasus tin pourer, rusty top; common automobilia, about $40-70.
Carlectables 1:18 Ambrose Falcon without box plus framed 8/100 tribute (not driver signed); about $80-150.
Four unmarked old planes, plough plane with irons the best piece; about $50-90 total.
Only one brick clearly broad arrow, others uncertain marks; local provenance helps but identification is doubtful, about $40-90.
Good 64 cm trout mount, no label; decor value about $50-100.
Genuine Cyclops pedal car in worn original paint with later stickers and possible replaced step; about $150-300.
Mixed rusty petroliana with a modern plastic container; common items, about $30-60.
Stihl MS 391 with bar and cover; used saws resell about $250-400 if running, working order unverified.
